title: TodoSyncReport
description: Result of one todo_sync.py check run, written atomically to <state_dir>/todo-sync/report.json and read by the todo-watch mod. Derived data: never committed, rewritten by every check.

schema_version.description: Report contract version; bumped on a breaking change.

generated_at.description: UTC time the check finished (ISO 8601). The pattern enforces the shape where no date-time format checker is installed.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the check run.

rules_run.description: Rule ids evaluated, in catalog order.

rules_skipped.description: Rule ids not evaluated, each with the reason (config key null, disabled, limited by --rules, input missing). A rule left out by --rules has the reason 'not selected': such a report covers a subset of the rules, and the todo-watch mod ignores it rather than read its drift as the whole project's.

drift.description: Number of counted findings: every error, plus every warn when todo.rules.warn_counts is true.

by_rule.description: Counted findings per rule id; rules with none are absent. Values sum to drift.

counts.description: All findings per severity, counted or not.

gh_fetched_at.description: fetched_at of the issue cache the G rules read (ISO 8601); null when no cache was read.

findings.description: Every finding, errors first, then by rule id and file.

rule_id.description: Sync rule id (S research, P plans, T TODO catalog, G GitHub).

counted.description: Whether this finding is part of drift.

file.description: Repo-relative POSIX path the finding is about; null when it has none. The one exception is a T1 finding on the harness fallback schema (todo.catalog_schema unset), which names the plugin-relative catalogs/TodoCatalog.schema.json; that path is not a consuming-repo file, so consumers treat a file that is not in the repo as a plugin schema reference and read the message.

subject.description: Record the finding is about: an item id, entry id, plan item id, '#<n>' for a tracker or issue number, or 'counts.<key>' for a catalog tally (the T9 rules); null when none applies.
